errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that all data points are marked with blue stars. The plot clearly shows that the data points for the first five epochs are marked with blue circles, while subsequent points are marked with blue stars.
The data point at Epoch 30 is visibly above the y=0.0000 axis line. Stating that the learning rate drops to exactly 0.0000 is an incorrect reading of the plot.
